values.note: 2027 on the booking site: 20/30-amp sites $34 weeknights, $37 Saturday; 50-amp sites $39 / $42 (probed 2027-05-20, 07-13 and Sat 07-17). The DNR's 2026 table: $32 (20/30 A) / $37 (50 A). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry.

values.note: Mostly level, grassy sites; a few unpaved pull-over sites carry the 50-amp service. The booking site maps 236 (46 with 50-amp); allowed equipment by site: 25 ft on 34, 30-35 ft on 102, 40-45 ft on 65, 50 ft on 20, 15 tent-only.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/brimley ('Number of sites: 237'; 'Most sites are level and grassy, and there are a few unpaved pull-over sites'; amenities 'Pull-through sites available') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (two maps, 120 + 116 campsites, allowedEquipment per site, largest class 'Trailer or RV up to 50''), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Three accessible modern restroom and shower buildings; seasonal sanitation station just before the campground entrance ($10 for non-campers). Vault toilet in the day-use area.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/brimley ('All three modern restroom and shower buildings are accessible'; 'a seasonal sanitation station'; 'The park's sanitation station is located just before the campground entrance ... A $10 fee will be assessed for those not camping in the park.'), read 2026-10-25

note: Modern campground on Lake Superior's Whitefish Bay, with 2,000 ft of sandy beach; open sites buffered from the shoreline by a vegetated windbreak, wooded on the south and east. Freighter-watching and a view of Canada from the day-use viewing area; shallow paved boat ramp. --Claude
